description: Evaluate a job, restaurant production run, delivery route, equipment purchase or staffing plan against explicit cost, capacity, earnings and timing limits. Return favorable/unfavorable feasibility, breaking points, permitted repairs and verification priorities. Zero permitted change locks an item. Uses original bounded workflow models built on established arithmetic and constraint methods; no world-first, forecast or obtainable-saving guarantee. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

availableHours.description: Productive person-hours currently available. Sum the available productive time of participating people for this job. Elapsed hours and person-hours differ.

extraHourCost.description: Incremental cost per added productive person-hour (USD). Added-capacity expense on top of planned labor and other costs. Use zero only if it is genuinely already included; otherwise include its full incremental cost.

fixed.description: Other entered costs for this job, run or route (USD). Costs not included in the separately entered labor, normal batch cost or mileage rate. Do not count both components and their total.

hoursHigh.description: High labor estimate (productive person-hours). Use a credible upper bound for the same scope, not a probability or guaranteed completion time.

hoursLow.description: Low labor estimate (productive person-hours). Job: productive person-hours. Delivery: elapsed hours including waiting, loading, stops, empty and return travel.

laborRate.description: Loaded labor cost for planned work (USD/person-hour). Job labor cost per productive person-hour, already including the employer costs you intend to cover. Do not enter the customer billing rate.

margin.description: Required margin after entered costs (%). Profit share of receipts after the costs you enter. Use 25 for 25%; less than 100%. This is not markup.

maxExtraHours.description: Additional productive capacity actually available (person-hours). Zero locks available capacity. Extra time does not reduce the original labor requirement.

maxPrice.description: Maximum permitted job-price increase (USD). Zero locks price. Job: total USD increase. Restaurant: USD increase per sold portion. Do not enter a change you cannot obtain.

maxSaving.description: Verified cost reduction available. Zero locks this cost. Job and delivery: reduction of Other entered costs, in USD. Restaurant: reduction per normal batch, in USD/batch. Do not subtract a saving already included in your base costs.

price.description: Current proposed job price (USD). Job: total proposed price before sales tax. Restaurant: collected receipts per sold portion, before sales tax. Select the workflow first.

batchCost.description: Normal cost per complete batch (USD). Include normal materials, labor and operating costs once. Extra labor/equipment capacity is charged separately at the rates below.

cashBudget.description: Maximum production cash cost (USD). Maximum entered cost for this whole production run, including extra capacity if used.

equipmentHours.description: Current equipment time available (hours). Available equipment-hours on the same basis as the per-batch equipment time.

equipmentMinutes.description: Sequential equipment time per batch (minutes). One equipment-hour pool, batches processed sequentially. This is not a multi-machine production scheduler.

extraEquipmentRate.description: Incremental cost per added equipment-hour (USD). Additional rental, operating or access cost per added hour; do not double-count an amount already in normal batch cost.

extraLaborRate.description: Incremental cost per added productive labor-hour (USD). Full additional cost, not a legal overtime multiplier. It is added to production cost when the capacity is used.

fixed.description: Other entered costs for this job, run or route (USD). Costs not included in the separately entered labor, normal batch cost or mileage rate. Do not count both components and their total.

laborHours.description: Current productive labor capacity (person-hours). Available productive person-hours for this run; sum people who can actually participate.

margin.description: Required margin after entered costs (%). Profit share of receipts after the costs you enter. Use 25 for 25%; less than 100%. This is not markup.

maxExtraEquipment.description: Additional sequential equipment time available (hours). Zero locks equipment time. Any added time must fit the actual service deadline and process requirements.

maxExtraLabor.description: Additional productive labor capacity available (person-hours). Zero locks labor capacity. Use an amount that can be supplied for this run.

maxPrice.description: Maximum permitted receipts increase (USD/portion). Zero locks price. Job: total USD increase. Restaurant: USD increase per sold portion. Do not enter a change you cannot obtain.

maxSaving.description: Verified cost reduction available. Zero locks this cost. Job and delivery: reduction of Other entered costs, in USD. Restaurant: reduction per normal batch, in USD/batch. Do not subtract a saving already included in your base costs.

personMinutesHigh.description: High productive person-minutes per batch. Include the normal preparation/handling tasks covered by your batch cost.

personMinutesLow.description: Low productive person-minutes per batch. Sum participating-person time; a two-person 15-minute task uses 30 person-minutes.

portions.description: Confirmed sellable portions required. Whole portions assumed sold at the entered receipts. This model does not assume uncertain demand will sell.

price.description: Collected receipts per sold portion (USD/portion). Job: total proposed price before sales tax. Restaurant: collected receipts per sold portion, before sales tax. Select the workflow first.

yieldHigh.description: High usable yield per complete batch (portions). Use the same recipe/batch basis as low yield. The high value must be at least the low value.

yieldLow.description: Low usable yield per complete batch (portions). Usable portions after your stated loss allowance, not raw ingredient weight. No further spoilage is inferred.

fixed.description: Other entered costs for this job, run or route (USD). Costs not included in the separately entered labor, normal batch cost or mileage rate. Do not count both components and their total.

hoursHigh.description: High all-in route time (elapsed hours). Use a credible upper bound for the same scope, not a probability or guaranteed completion time.

hoursLow.description: Low all-in route time (elapsed hours). Job: productive person-hours. Delivery: elapsed hours including waiting, loading, stops, empty and return travel.

maxRevenue.description: Additional guaranteed route receipts available (USD). Zero locks receipts. This is an actual available improvement, not an assumed tip or newly offered order.

maxSaving.description: Verified cost reduction available. Zero locks this cost. Job and delivery: reduction of Other entered costs, in USD. Restaurant: reduction per normal batch, in USD/batch. Do not subtract a saving already included in your base costs.

maxTime.description: Verified time reduction available on the route (hours). Zero locks route time. Use only an achievable operational change; the worksheet does not optimize stops or assume faster driving.

milesHigh.description: High ALL driven miles for route. A credible upper bound for the same route scope.

milesLow.description: Low ALL driven miles for route. Include loaded, empty, repositioning and return miles.

perMile.description: Vehicle cost per ALL mile (USD/mile). Your fuel, tires, maintenance and allocated vehicle costs per all mile. Exclude your own labor earnings when also using the earnings target.

revenueHigh.description: High total route receipts (USD). A stated upper scenario, not promised work or income.

revenueLow.description: Low total route receipts (USD). Separate guaranteed receipts from uncertain tips or incentives. No platform pay rates are looked up.

targetHourly.description: Required contribution per all-in hour (USD/hour). Target after entered vehicle/other costs, before income tax and omitted expenses. This is not a wage-law calculation.

windowHours.description: Available elapsed time for route (hours). A hard elapsed-time limit, including waiting and return travel.

benefitHigh.description: High annual incremental NET benefit (USD/year). Same annual scope as the low benefit. Do not substitute gross sales.

benefitLow.description: Low annual incremental NET benefit (USD/year). Incremental receipts or savings minus incremental annual operating, labor and maintenance costs. A negative value is allowed.

cash.description: Own cash currently available for purchase (USD). Available funding for the purchase; no unentered loan or grant is assumed.

installation.description: Installation and acquisition extras (USD). One-time installation, delivery and other acquisition cash costs, counted once.

maxBenefit.description: Verified improvement to annual NET benefit (USD/year). Zero locks annual benefit. Use only an achievable change not already included in the annual benefit range.

maxCash.description: Additional verified OWN cash available (USD). Zero locks your funding. Additional own cash does not improve payback and is not an unmodeled loan.

maxDiscount.description: Verified purchase-price reduction available (USD). Zero locks purchase price. Discount cannot exceed purchase price and does not reduce installation automatically.

minimumBenefit.description: Minimum acceptable annual net benefit (USD/year). A hard minimum; zero means you require at least nonnegative annual net benefit.

purchase.description: Equipment purchase price (USD). Quoted acquisition price before the separately entered installation/extras.

years.description: Maximum acceptable simple payback (years). A positive horizon using equal annual benefits, without discounting, tax or residual value.

budget.description: Maximum staffing cost for period (USD). Includes regular staffing and any added hires, overtime or outsourcing.

loadedRate.description: Loaded cost per regular PAID hour (USD/hour). Employer labor cost per paid hour, not cost per productive hour.

maxHires.description: Additional whole workers actually available (0–20). Zero locks hiring. Each added worker receives the full entered regular paid hours in this period.

maxOutsource.description: Outsourced productive hours available. Delivered productive person-hours, not paid employee hours. Zero locks outsourcing.

maxOvertime.description: Additional paid overtime hours available across team. Total extra paid hours, not per-worker hours. Zero locks overtime. Availability and legal limits must be checked separately.

outsourceRate.description: Quoted cost per outsourced PRODUCTIVE hour (USD/hour). Full supplier cost per delivered productive hour, using the same task scope.

overtimeRate.description: Loaded cost per additional PAID hour (USD/hour). Full incremental employer cost. No statutory rate or multiplier is selected for you.

paidHours.description: Paid hours per regular worker in period. Use the same week, month or other period for workload, wages, capacity and budget.

productive.description: Productive share of paid time (%). Your measured or explicitly assumed productive share. Applied to both regular and added paid overtime hours.

workHigh.description: High required workload (productive person-hours). Credible upper workload for the same tasks and period.

workLow.description: Low required workload (productive person-hours). Sum task person-hours, not elapsed crew-hours.

workers.description: Current regular workers assigned to this period. Whole workers with the paid hours and productive share below. This aggregate model assumes interchangeable coverage.
